title: Best Men's Suit 2026: 5 suits compared at office, wedding, and interview
description: Suitsupply, Brooks Brothers, Indochino, J.Crew, Hugo Boss — worn 60 days. Fit, drape after 8 hrs sitting, half-canvas vs fused construction.
lede: Five men's suits tested by the same 6'1" 175lb tester over 60 days. Half-canvas vs fused construction, drape after 8-hour sitting test, MTM vs off-the-rack.
methodology: Same tester. Each suit worn 12 days across business meetings, a wedding, 2 interviews. Steamed daily, no dry-cleaning between wears. Tailor assessed fit at day 1, 30, 60.

sections.heading: Construction and cost-quality
paragraphs: Half-canvas (Suitsupply, Brooks Brothers) held shape over 60 days. Fused (Indochino, J.Crew, Hugo Boss) all held at day 30; J.Crew showed slight chest bubbling at day 60.
Suitsupply at $499 outperformed Hugo Boss at $895 on construction and Italian wool. Indochino MTM at $399 beat off-the-rack J.Crew for athletic builds.

faqs.q: Half-canvas vs fused — does it matter?
faqs.a: Fused is fine if you wear under 10 times/year (saves $300-500). Half-canvas pays off above 20 wears/year — drape lasts 5-10 years vs 3-5 for fused.
Yes if you're not standard 38R/40R/42R. The Indochino MTM at $399 fits better than $700 off-the-rack on athletic builds. Standard build = save the money.

suitsupply-napoli-wool.review: Best overall. Half-canvas Italian construction at $499 outperforms most $1000+ suits. Napoli soft shoulder works for most body types.

brooks-brothers-fitzgerald.review: 200-year heritage in half-canvas construction. Fitzgerald slim is the best Brooks Brothers cut for modern bodies.

indochino-essential-suit.review: MTM value champion. 30+ measurements catch off-the-rack misses. Fused but the fit beats $700+ off-the-rack.

jcrew-ludlow-suit.review: American tailored fit with Italian wool, sales bring this to $300. Fused chest bubbled after 60 humid days.

hugo-boss-huge-genius.review: German precision and stretch fabric option. Price-to-construction is the weakest in test.

pinDescription: Tested 5 men's suits over 60 days. Suitsupply vs Brooks Brothers vs Indochino vs J.Crew vs Hugo Boss. Half-canvas vs fused. #menssuit #mensfashion
